units.source_text: 阿阇梨今已任律师之职。

en.t: The ajari had now been appointed to the office of risshi.

units.source_text: 薰大将召唤他到山庄来，

en.t: Captain Kaoru summoned him to the mountain villa,

units.source_text: 吩咐他为浮舟举办法事，叫他增添念佛僧侣人数。

en.t: and instructed him to hold memorial rites for Ukifune and to increase the number of monks chanting the nenbutsu.

units.source_text: 自杀罪障甚深，故必须举办可以减轻罪障的法事。

en.t: Because the karmic burden of suicide was very grave, rites had to be performed to lessen that burden.

units.source_text: 关于每个七日的诵经供养办法，均有详细指示。

en.t: He gave detailed instructions for the sutra recitations and offerings to be made on each seventh day.

units.source_text: 天色已经很暗，薰大将准备返京，

en.t: The sky had already grown very dark, and Captain Kaoru prepared to return to the capital,

units.source_text: 心中反复思量：“如果浮舟在世，我今夜不会就此归去。”

en.t: thinking again and again in his heart, If Ukifune were alive, I would not go back like this tonight.
He called for the elderly nun Ben no Kimi.

units.source_text: 弁君派人代答道：“此身太不祥了，

en.t: Ben no Kimi sent someone to answer for her, saying, This body of mine is far too inauspicious,

units.source_text: 为此日夜愁叹，神思愈益昏迷，

en.t: and because of it I grieve day and night, while my mind grows ever more clouded,
so I can only lie here blankly and weakly.
She refused to come out and meet him.

units.source_text: 薰大将也不定要进去看她，就此上道。

en.t: Captain Kaoru did not insist on going in to see her, and set out on his way.

units.source_text: 他在归途上痛悔不曾早日迎接浮舟入京，

en.t: On the road back, he bitterly regretted not having brought Ukifune to the capital sooner,

units.source_text: 听到宇治川的水声，心如刀割，

en.t: and when he heard the sound of the Uji River, his heart felt as though it were being cut by a blade,

units.source_text: 想道：“连遗骸也找不到，何等悲惨的死别啊！

en.t: and he thought, Not even her remains can be found. What a wretched parting in death this is!

units.source_text: 不知她现在怎样，在何处海底与贝介为伍？”

en.t: I wonder what has become of her now, and on what seabed she lies among the shells.
He could find no way to comfort himself in his sorrow.
